I just had to share with someone. For the first time in my life, I understand what tears of joy feel like. I have been so worried for so long about her.

She's been battling Crohns disease for about three years, but about two or three months ago she started experiencing SIGNIFICANT pain. She was constantly nearly doubled over with it, and waking up screaming was a nightly occurrence.

The pain got so bad that in August we thought her appendix had burst or was about to, and we went into the emergency room for help. They performed a CT scan, which revealed a thickening between the bridge between her large and small intestine. They told us it was just the Crohns, and that it had traveled a little and she wluld just have to deal with it, then gave us some useless pain meds and sebt us home. We tried going to the free clinic a few weeks ago, but after waiting for hours they told us that they were full up and couldn't do anything.

I got scared. Like, really scared, she'd been waking up screaming for months, constantly in debilitating pain, and I started feeling like she was going to die because no one would help us.

Finally, last weekend she could barely get out of bed at all, and on Sunday we went to the Indian hospital three towns away. They took her in immediately and did a CT scan within an hour. That revealed that a large abscess had formed in her intestine and it required immediate emergency surgery. They took her by ambulance back into town to a bigger hospital with an excellent surgery team. After a sleepless night, they were prepared to perform surgery in the morning.

It took over two hours. In that time, I think that was the first time I truly prayed in my life. When the surgery team came out and told us it was a complete success with the bowel resection surgery and appendectomy, I nearly collapsed.

It's been a tough road, but the doctors say this will knock the Crohns into remission for at least a few years, and she will feel better than she has in a very long time. Tomorrow I finally get to bring my pretty girl home!
